singleSourceRule: All current status mirrors must derive their current phase, gate and write boundary from this index and the active change-control. Snapshot headers inside sealed historical files do not define current project status.
readOrder: current task Acceptance, critic, judge, evidence and live read-back
PROJECT_STATUS.json, AI_PROJECT_POLICY.json, QUALITY_GATE.md, PROJECT_HANDOVER.md, AGENTS.md and workflow status
chat history, reference images and general knowledge

active.role: project-wide authority, safety and operating rules
low-rework production method, downstream-usability contract and phase sequencing
installation and replacement manifest for ChatGPT Project sources

mustNotBeActiveAsProjectSources: any prior downloaded copy of CHATGPT_PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS1.md

modelValidation.limitation: Step 3 validates the sealed model and transition tests. It is not evidence that the current browser runtime implements the canonical game or that real players completed runtime playtests. Runtime implementation must later share the domain engine and be revalidated.

deliverables: G asset decomposition and animation contract

legacyRuntime.allowedUse: technical history and temporary comparison only
legacyRuntime.forbiddenUse: may not be described as the current canonical 1-10F implementation and may not receive incremental production polish during S02-P1

scopedVerdicts.PASS_CANONICAL: product meaning, IDs, state and trust boundaries are sealed
scopedVerdicts.PASS_CONTRACT: schema, validator, fixture and model contract are executable
scopedVerdicts.PASS_MODEL: the sealed model passed its stated simulations and transition tests
scopedVerdicts.PASS_VISUAL: the actual required rendered states and viewports passed independent visual review
scopedVerdicts.PASS_ASSET: production assets passed decomposition, animation, budget, provenance and in-engine proof
scopedVerdicts.PASS_RUNTIME: the canonical product is implemented in the runtime and passed browser interaction and regression
scopedVerdicts.PASS_SERVER: authoritative transactions, ledger, recovery, security and reconciliation passed
scopedVerdicts.PASS_RELEASE: all release gates passed with unresolved P0 and P1 equal to zero

keep: quality-reviews/** acceptance, critic, judge, completion and live-readback artifacts
doNotUseAsCurrentAuthority: snapshot status headers inside sealed documents
